Meeting Date:                 9/21/2022
Sponsor(s):                   King (4)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 10-E at 757-773 E
                              Oakwood Blvd
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all ofthe B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 10-E in the
area bound by:

       East Oakwood Boulevard; South Cottage Grove Avenue; a line 129.6 feet south of and
       parallel to East Oakwood Boulevard; and a line 175 feet west of and parallel to South
       Cottage Grove Avenue,

to those of a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         Sojshia D. Kin
                                                          laerman, 4*'' Ward




Common Address:
757-773 E. Oakwood Blvd.
